metadata.description: Security operations plugins for Claude Code: threat modeling, detection and incident response, authorized security testing, cloud and container security, application security, and compliance.

plugins.name: api-security-testing
plugins.description: API security assessment for REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and WebSocket interfaces against the OWASP API Security Top 10, including authentication flow audits and secure auth patterns.

plugins.name: blue-team-detection
plugins.description: Detection engineering and threat hunting: Sigma and YARA rules with SIEM translations, detection-as-code, and hypothesis-driven hunts mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

plugins.name: bug-bounty-methodology
plugins.description: Methodology for authorized bug bounty programs: scope-respecting reconnaissance, attack surface mapping, and vulnerability reports that triagers can reproduce.

plugins.name: cloud-security-aws
plugins.description: Defensive AWS security: IAM, S3, VPC, KMS, and logging architecture reviews, CIS and Well-Architected compliance audits, and hardening patterns.

plugins.name: cloud-security-azure
plugins.description: Defensive Azure security: Entra ID, Conditional Access, RBAC, networking, storage, and Key Vault reviews, plus CIS Azure and Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark audits.

plugins.name: cloud-security-gcp
plugins.description: Defensive Google Cloud security: IAM and Workload Identity, Organization Policies, VPC Service Controls, and CIS GCP benchmark audits.

plugins.name: compliance-frameworks
plugins.description: Compliance assessment, gap analysis, and audit evidence planning for SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, and NIST frameworks.

plugins.name: container-security
plugins.description: Container security for Docker and Podman: Dockerfile and Compose hardening, image vulnerability scanning with SBOMs, and runtime isolation.

plugins.name: cryptography-essentials
plugins.description: Cryptography guidance: algorithm and parameter selection, password hashing, key management and rotation, TLS configuration, and crypto code audits.

plugins.name: devsecops-pipelines
plugins.description: Security-integrated CI/CD: pipeline security architecture, SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, and container scanning in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Jenkins, and build-breaking security gates.

plugins.name: forensics-analysis
plugins.description: Digital forensics for authorized investigations: investigation planning, chain of custody, disk and artifact analysis, timelines, and memory forensics with Volatility.

plugins.name: identity-access-management
plugins.description: Identity and access management: IAM architecture, SSO and MFA design, RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC access control models, authentication flow review, and access audits.

plugins.name: incident-response
plugins.description: Security incident response: incident command and coordination, forensic evidence handling, playbooks for common incident types, and blameless postmortems.

plugins.name: kubernetes-security
plugins.description: Kubernetes security: cluster hardening, RBAC audits, Pod Security Standards, NetworkPolicy, and admission control with Gatekeeper or Kyverno.

plugins.name: malware-analysis
plugins.description: Defensive malware analysis for incident responders: triage, static and sandbox-based dynamic analysis in an isolated lab, IOC extraction, and detection signatures.

plugins.name: mobile-app-security
plugins.description: Mobile application security for Android and iOS: OWASP MASVS/MASTG assessments, secure code review, hardening checklists, and mobile crypto patterns.

plugins.name: network-security
plugins.description: Network security: firewall rules, segmentation and trust zones, IDS/IPS with Suricata, Snort, and Zeek, VPN review, and network audits.

plugins.name: penetration-testing
plugins.description: Penetration testing methodology for authorized assessments: scoping and rules of engagement, attack surface mapping, test planning, and risk-rated vulnerability analysis.

plugins.name: privacy-engineering
plugins.description: Privacy engineering: privacy by design, GDPR data protection impact assessments, personal data flow mapping, and technical privacy controls.

plugins.name: red-team-operations
plugins.description: Adversary simulation planning for authorized red and purple team engagements: rules of engagement, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and detection validation.

plugins.name: secrets-management
plugins.description: Secrets management: leaked secret detection, vault architecture with HashiCorp Vault and cloud secret managers, secret injection, and credential rotation.

plugins.name: secure-coding-practices
plugins.description: Secure coding: security-focused code review, injection prevention, secure authentication and session patterns, and targeted vulnerability fixes.

plugins.name: security-automation
plugins.description: Security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR): platform selection, playbook design, and working automation for alert enrichment, phishing triage, and containment with human approval gates.

plugins.name: security-awareness
plugins.description: Security awareness training and policy: role-based training, authorized phishing simulations for an organization's own staff, and plain-language security policies mapped to regulations.

plugins.name: security-hardening
plugins.description: System hardening and CIS Benchmark assessment for Linux and Windows hosts, containers, Kubernetes, web servers, databases, and cloud accounts, with implementation and verification steps.

plugins.name: siem-log-management
plugins.description: SIEM and log management: SIEM architecture and log source planning, detection and hunting queries in Splunk SPL, Elastic KQL/EQL, and Sentinel KQL, and cross-source event correlation.

plugins.name: social-engineering-defense
plugins.description: Social engineering defense: analysis of phishing, BEC, vishing, and physical pretexts, organizational exposure assessments, layered technical and human controls, and awareness programs.

plugins.name: supply-chain-security
plugins.description: Software supply chain security: dependency vulnerability and license audits, SBOM generation, and detection of typosquatting, dependency confusion, and compromised packages.

plugins.name: threat-modeling
plugins.description: Threat modeling with STRIDE, attack trees, DREAD risk ranking, and MITRE ATT&CK mapping that turns a design into ranked threats with concrete mitigations.

plugins.name: vulnerability-scanning
plugins.description: Vulnerability scanning and triage for systems you own or are authorized to assess: scanner selection across SAST, SCA, container, IaC, cloud, and secrets, plus CVSS and exploitability-based prioritization.

plugins.name: web-application-security
plugins.description: Web application security: OWASP Top 10 (2021) source code audits and cross-site scripting analysis with context-correct fixes for common web frameworks.

plugins.name: zero-trust-architecture
plugins.description: Zero trust architecture: NIST SP 800-207 design, CISA maturity assessments, and microsegmentation with network policies, service mesh authorization, and workload identity.

plugins.name: libre-secops-hooks
plugins.description: Optional security hooks: a one-line security profile of the project at session start, a confirmation prompt before Claude edits secret or key files, and a local pattern scan for vulnerabilities after each edit.
